notes.title: Pokertown: Cheater’s Paradise Demo is now live
notes.content:
The demo for Pokertown: Cheater’s Paradise is available to download now.

In this demo, you'll learn how to mark cards and get to practice cheating against a table of some wild and unpredictable amateur poker players. 
Practice marking cards and see how each one tilts the odds of the game in your favor. Just don't get caught.

The full game will teach you more cheating methods to play against stronger opponents, progress through tournaments, and build a reputation in Pokertown.

If you enjoy the demo, wishlist the full game on Steam to stay updated.

Share any crazy hands or moments in the Steam Community and let us know how your run went.

[previewyoutube=7WnReBPwtR4;full][/previewyoutube]

Download the demo now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417310/
